items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Yes, I knew him in New York. Played with Clarence Williams.

ctx.x: I wish you could find a picture of the craftsman band.
And that's Valtuli on violin. I've never seen his picture. And Keeling. And Valtuli is a very nice looking man. Yes, he is.
I wonder where we could find that, I don't know, we lost the picture of the old Excelsior band. It was around here and I don't know what happened to it.
